articles.title: Bitcoin, ether decline as Coldcard exploit enters a fifth day
articles.snippet: Nevertheless, the drop in crypto prices seems restrained given the magnitude of losses in the wallet hack and the erosion of confidence in cold storage.

articles.title: Unlike the FTX collapse, the $89 million Coldcard exploit has investors sending bitcoin back to exchanges
articles.snippet: The Coldcard vulnerability has smaller bitcoin holders moving funds onto exchanges for safety, according to blockchain analytics firms. This is opposite of the trend seen following the FTX collapse in late 2022.

articles.title: Coldcard exploit sparks Bitcoin flight, ‘bullish’ crypto consolidation: Hodler’s Digest, August 2
articles.snippet: The “sickening” loss of $90 million of Bitcoin from cold storage weighs heavily on sentiment, as the Clarity Act stalls with just five days left to hold a Senate vote.

articles.title: Coldcard Bitcoin Exploit Balloons to $88 Million as Attackers Keep Draining Wallets
articles.snippet: Galaxy Research says a third wave of thefts from Coldcard Bitcoin wallets has pushed observed losses to roughly 1,367 BTC across 4,585 addresses.

articles.title: CZ Warns Bitcoin Holders After $70 Million Wallet Exploit: 'Nothing Is 100%'
articles.snippet: The Binance founder urged holders to spread funds across multiple wallets as Galaxy Research put the toll from the Coldcard exploit at roughly $70 million—nearly double the initial estimate.
